Text_Previous:
An easy way to initialize an object: New object

The New object command creates a new empty or prefilled object and returns its reference.

2 syntaxes can be used to initialize an object with New object:

-Without parameter, it creates an empty object and returns its reference:
$obj:=New object

-With parameters, it prefills the new object with the given properties and values
$obj:=New object( "name "; "Smith "; "age ";40)


With this HDI, you can compare the 4D code with and without New object.
